**Implementation note:** X3 picks the top-1 of a small ETF universe by trailing return; no stock-universe ranking or short side.

## Description

Rank assets by trailing returns and buy leaders, optionally shorting laggards.

## Where it may fit

Persistent relative leadership and broad dispersion across assets; may reverse sharply after crowded trends.

## Vehicles

Long-short equity funds, sector ETFs, country ETFs, commodity futures, FX baskets.

## Required data

Point-in-time prices/total returns for a universe; membership history; liquidity; borrow availability; rebalance dates.

## Caveats

Use a survivorship-bias-free universe and account for crash risk, short costs, and turnover.
